race.comment: POMAH (10) resumes. She just found one narrowly better first up at Sale last time in which then saw her well backed in a strong maiden next time out and covering ground. Shinn goes on here, she finds a winnable race and looks well placed. BJORSON (1) has been sound in two runs to date here, placing on debut at big odds before a close up fourth last start. Back in trip looks fine, he'll give a sight up on speed. GALACTIC GIRL (8) was poor last time but is right in this off the placing behind Here's Matilda two back which is strong form. SPIRIT OF GAIA (11) is racing well but struggling to break through. She was off a break between runs latest and can strip fitter with claims.
